name: Daoming Optics&Chemical Co.,Ltd
summary: Daoming Optics&Chemical Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of various functional films and polymer synthetic materials in China and internationally. The company offers personal protection solutions, including normal reflective fabric, reflective leather and yarn, finished, reflective clothing, heat transfer film, prismatic reflective tape, flame retardant, industrial washable, elastic reflective fabric, photoluminescent, and fancy fabric products.
